Specifically, weighing the closest semantic and physical matches (big_stone and multimeter) relative to the query mass (286.71 g) and roughness (1847.68), yielding an estimate around 3.85 N.

Uncertainty arises from the moderate roughness index which reduces optimal van der Waals adhesion compared to perfectly smooth surfaces.
Projected contact fraction is treated as a dimensionless contact proxy rather than absolute geometric area.

Given the moderate-to-high roughness which partially degrades gecko adhesion, a higher normal force than smooth objects is required, but mitigated by favorable mass-to-contact scaling. This leads to a consistent intermediate normal force estimate of 3.85 N.
